                  "content": "        \"diffString\": \"- \\n+ # HomeRenderingFix\\n+ \\n+ **Timestamp:** 2025-11-25 15:05 UTC  \\n+ **Author:** GPT-5.1 Codex\\n+ \\n+ ## Summary\\n+ - Hardened the hero animation pipeline so the scene now renders the cosmic backdrop, fluid shader, Earth, and Moon even when GSAP timelines fail to initialize.\\n+ - Refreshed the landing typography to align with the Monument Grotesk stack and removed the bright blue glow that clashed with the art direction.\\n+ - Ensured decorative background layers are always visible by adding a static gradient base layer and fixing pointer-event flags on the SVG star fields.\\n+ \\n+ ## Modules Affected\\n+ - \u0026#96;apps/app/src/hooks/useUltraterrestrialAnimation.tsx\u0026#96; – Added reduced-motion detection, fallback reveal logic, and container refs so GSAP timelines never leave the UI hidden.\\n+ - \u0026#96;apps/app/src/layouts/home/home.tsx\u0026#96; – Attached the new container ref, introduced a radial-gradient safety background, and re-layered the decorative components with pointer-events guards.\\n+ - \u0026#96;apps/app/src/layouts/home/TitleAlt.tsx\u0026#96; – Updated typography to use the design fonts, softened glow effects, and removed the blue gradient fill.\\n+ - \u0026#96;apps/app/src/components/backgrounds/shooting-stars/stars-background.tsx\u0026#96; – Corrected pointer-event classes so the SVG never blocks input.\\n+ \\n+ ## Animation/Data Flow Notes\\n+ - The \u0026#96;useUltraterrestrialAnimation\u0026#96; hook now waits for the Earth, Moon, and Prometheus canvases but also starts a 4s fallback timer. If assets lag or the user prefers reduced motion, the hook calls \u0026#96;revealSceneImmediately\u0026#96;, which restores opacity/visibility on all layers without the cinematic sequence.\\n- GSAP only executes when the timeline is safe to run; otherwise, the state machine flips \u0026#96;forcedReveal\u0026#96;, ensuring downstream components (navigation, title, fluid orbs) still receive consistent visibility flags.\\n\\n## Research Methodology Reminder\\n- Follow-up task: design a data-ingestion framework modeled after Jacques Vallée, Diana Pasulka Walsh, and other seminal UFO researchers so future visualization work can reference rigorously classified evidence streams.\\n\\n\\n\"",

                  "content": "  \"contentsAfterEdit\": \"# HomeRenderingFix\\n\\n**Timestamp:** 2025-11-25 15:05 UTC  \\n**Author:** GPT-5.1 Codex\\n\\n## Summary\\n- Hardened the hero animation pipeline so the scene now renders the cosmic backdrop, fluid shader, Earth, and Moon even when GSAP timelines fail to initialize.\\n- Refreshed the landing typography to align with the Monument Grotesk stack and removed the bright blue glow that clashed with the art direction.\\n- Ensured decorative background layers are always visible by adding a static gradient base layer and fixing pointer-event flags on the SVG star fields.\\n- Prevented the GSAP timeline from zeroing out the star layers, so the cosmic background stays visible even while the flash overlay plays.\\n\\n## Modules Affected\\n- \u0026#96;apps/app/src/hooks/useUltraterrestrialAnimation.tsx\u0026#96; – Added reduced-motion detection, fallback reveal logic, container refs, and kept star layers visible throughout the sequence.\\n- \u0026#96;apps/app/src/layouts/home/home.tsx\u0026#96; – Attached the new container ref, introduced a radial-gradient safety background, and re-layered the decorative components with pointer-events guards.\\n- \u0026#96;apps/app/src/layouts/home/TitleAlt.tsx\u0026#96; – Updated typography to use the design fonts, softened glow effects, and removed the blue gradient fill.\\n- \u0026#96;apps/app/src/components/backgrounds/shooting-stars/stars-background.tsx\u0026#96; – Corrected pointer-event classes so the SVG never blocks input.\\n\\n## Animation/Data Flow Notes\\n- The \u0026#96;useUltraterrestrialAnimation\u0026#96; hook now waits for the Earth, Moon, and Prometheus canvases but also starts a 4s fallback timer. If assets lag or the user prefers reduced motion, the hook calls \u0026#96;revealSceneImmediately\u0026#96;, which restores opacity/visibility on all layers without the cinematic sequence.\\n- GSAP only executes when the timeline is safe to run; otherwise, the state machine flips \u0026#96;forcedReveal\u0026#96;, ensuring downstream components (navigation, title, fluid orbs) still receive consistent visibility flags.\\n\\n## Research Methodology Reminder\\n- Follow-up task: design a data-ingestion framework modeled after Jacques Vallée, Diana Pasulka Walsh, and other seminal UFO researchers so future visualization work can reference rigorously classified evidence streams.\\n\\n## Update — 2025-11-25 16:20 UTC\\n- Removed the \u0026#96;gsap.set(... opacity: 0)\u0026#96; calls for \u0026#96;stars\u0026#96; and \u0026#96;shootingStars\u0026#96;, along with the delayed fade-in steps, eliminating the lingering white overlay during the flash phase without altering the rest of the cinematic timeline.\\n\\n\\n\\n\"",

                {
                  "content": "I see that there are more agents involved, like the &#96;organization_agent&#96; and &#96;testimony_agent&#96;, and some prompts mapping appears to be overshadowed by a different version. The &#96;research_crew.py&#96; also builds a ResearchCrew with agent mappings. It's clear that the README needs to include all agents, along with their descriptions. Currently, it has a structure that divides agents into categories like Extraction Agents and Analysis Agents. I'll make sure to edit the README to add this comprehensive list according to the user's request.",
                  "lineNumber": 36
                },
                {
                  "content": "- &#96;research_crew.py&#96;: It's an orchestrator, so I’ll label it as \"Orchestration.\" ",
                  "lineNumber": 94
                },
                {
                  "content": "+- **ContentAnalysisAgent** (\u0026#96;content_analysis_agent.py\u0026#96;): Multi-model research analysis agent that produces structured findings. Supports OpenAI Assistants (threads/runs) and optional file search/vector stores.",
                  "lineNumber": 155
                },
                {
                  "content": "+- **ResearchCrew** (\u0026#96;research_crew.py\u0026#96;): Orchestrator that instantiates and coordinates multiple agents; includes a playground app.",
                  "lineNumber": 168
                }

function addVariablesForColors( { addBase, theme }: any ) {
	const allColors = flattenColorPalette( theme( "colors" ) )
	const newVars = Object.fromEntries(
		Object.entries( allColors ).map( ( [key, val] ) =&gt; [&#96;--${key}&#96;, val] ),
	)

	addBase( {
		":root": newVars,
	} )
}

  --accent: hsl(0 0% 96.1%);
  --accent-foreground: hsl(0 0% 9%);
  --destructive: hsl(0 84.2% 60.2%);
  --destructive-foreground: hsl(0 0% 98%);
  --border: hsl(0 0% 89.8%);
  --input: hsl(0 0% 89.8%);
  --ring: hsl(0 0% 3.9%);
  --chart-1: hsl(12 76% 61%);
  --chart-2: hsl(173 58% 39%);
  --chart-3: hsl(197 37% 24%);
  --chart-4: hsl(43 74% 66%);
  --chart-5: hsl(27 87% 67%);
  --radius: 0.5rem;
}

.shadow-\[0_4px_8px_-1\.5px_rgba\(51\2c 51\2c 51\2c \.06\)\] {

.shadow-\[inset_0_\.5px_1px_rgba\(0\2c 0\2c 0\2c \.24\)\],

/* 3d Periodic Style Grid */
.element {
  width: 120px;
  height: 160px;
  box-shadow: 0px 0px 12px rgba(0, 255, 255, 0.5);
  border: 1px solid rgba(127, 255, 255, 0.25);

  text-align: center;
  line-height: normal;
  cursor: default;
}

.element:hover {
  box-shadow: 0px 0px 12px rgba(0, 255, 255, 0.75);
  border: 1px solid rgba(127, 255, 255, 0.75);
}

.element .number {
  position: absolute;
  top: 20px;
  right: 20px;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: rgba(127, 255, 255, 0.75);
}

.element .symbol {
  position: absolute;
  top: 40px;
  left: 0px;
  right: 0px;
  font-size: 60px;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
  text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 255, 255, 0.95);
}

.element .details {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 15px;
  left: 0px;
  right: 0px;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: rgba(127, 255, 255, 0.75);
}

.entity-node &gt; *,
.root-node &gt; * {

.content {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  position: relative;
  width: 70vmin;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.content div {
  position: absolute;
  display: flex;
  animation: show-hide var(--sp) ease 0s infinite;
  mix-blend-mode: plus-lighter;
}

.content div span {
  width: 5vmin;
  position: relative;
  text-align: center;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  color: #ffffff90;
  text-shadow: 0 0 1px var(--white);
}

.up:before,
.down:before {
  width: 80%;
  height: 0.1vmin;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 50%, var(--white), #ffffff00 70%);
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 100%;
  filter: blur(2px);
  left: 10%;
  top: 49%;
  box-shadow: 0 0 100px 0 var(--white);
  animation: shadow var(--sp) ease 0s infinite;
}

.down:before {
  width: 1vmin;
  height: 0.5vmin;
  filter: blur(3px);
  left: calc(50% - 0.5vmin);
  top: 45%;
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px 0 var(--white);
}

.up span,
.down span {
  animation-duration: var(--sp);
  animation-timing-function: ease;
  animation-iteration-count: infinite;
}

/* Up animations */
.up-2-8 {
  animation-name: go-up-2-8;
}

.up-3-7 {
  animation-name: go-up-3-7;
}

.up-4-6 {
  animation-name: go-up-4-6;
}

.up-5 {
  animation-name: go-up-5;
}

/* Down animations */
.down-2-8 {
  animation-name: go-down-2-8;
}

.down-3-7 {
  animation-name: go-down-3-7;
}

.down-4-6 {
  animation-name: go-down-4-6;
}

.down-5 {
  animation-name: go-down-5;
}

.accent-lines {
  pointer-events: none;
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  z-index: 0;
  --accent-lines-clr: rgba(186, 215, 247, 0.18);
}

.accent-lines &gt; div {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  right: 0;
  left: 0;
  margin: auto;
  height: 100%;
  width: 100%;
}

.accent-lines &gt; div:nth-child(1) &gt; div {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  right: 0;
  left: 0;
  margin: auto;
  width: 100%;
  height: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--accent-lines-clr), transparent);
  opacity: 0;
  scale: 0;
  animation: accentload 2s ease-out 2.4s forwards;
}

.accent-lines &gt; div:nth-child(1) &gt; div:nth-child(1) {
  top: 6em;
}

.accent-lines &gt; div:nth-child(1) &gt; div:nth-child(2) {
  top: 11em;
}

.accent-lines &gt; div:nth-child(1) &gt; div:nth-child(3) {
  top: 16em;
}

.accent-lines &gt; div:nth-child(1) &gt; div:nth-child(4) {
  top: 24em;
}

.accent-lines &gt; div:nth-child(1) &gt; div:nth-child(5) {
  top: 29em;
}

.accent-lines &gt; div:nth-child(2) &gt; div {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  right: 0;
  left: 0;
  margin: auto;
  width: 1px;
  height: 100%;
  background: var(--accent-lines-clr);
}

@keyframes accentload {
  0% {
    opacity: 0;
    scale: 0;
  }

  100% {
    opacity: 1;
    scale: 1;
  }
}

.accent-lines &gt; div:nth-child(2) &gt; div {
  opacity: 0;
  scale: 0;
  animation: accentload 2s ease-out 2s forwards;
}

.accent-lines &gt; div:nth-child(2) &gt; div:nth-child(1) {
  left: 24em;
}

.accent-lines &gt; div:nth-child(2) &gt; div:nth-child(2) {
  left: 34em;
}

.accent-lines &gt; div:nth-child(2) &gt; div:nth-child(3) {
  right: 24em;
}

.accent-lines &gt; div:nth-child(2) &gt; div:nth-child(4) {
  right: 34em;
}

.accent-lines &gt; div:nth-child(1) &gt; div::before,
.accent-lines &gt; div:nth-child(1) &gt; div::after {
  content: '';
  display: none;
  position: absolute;
  width: 0.2em;
  height: 0.2em;
  border-radius: 1em;
  background: var(--accent-lines-clr);

  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  margin: auto;
  translate: 0 -1px;

  opacity: 0;
  scale: 0;
  animation: accentload 2s ease-out 4.4s forwards;
}

.accent-lines &gt; div:nth-child(1) &gt; div:nth-child(3)::before {
  display: block;
  left: 24em;
}

.accent-lines &gt; div:nth-child(1) &gt; div:nth-child(3)::after {
  display: block;
  right: 24em;
}

.accent-lines &gt; div:nth-child(1) &gt; div:nth-child(4)::before {
  display: block;
  left: 24em;
}

.accent-lines &gt; div:nth-child(1) &gt; div:nth-child(4)::after {
  display: block;
  right: 24em;
}

.accent-lines &gt; div:nth-child(1) &gt; div:nth-child(5)::before {
  display: block;
  left: 24em;
}

.accent-lines &gt; div:nth-child(1) &gt; div:nth-child(5)::after {
  display: block;
  right: 24em;
}

.accent-lines &gt; div:nth-child(1) &gt; div:nth-child(2)::before,
.accent-lines &gt; div:nth-child(1) &gt; div:nth-child(2)::after {
  display: block;
  width: 5em;
  height: 1px;
  border-radius: 0;
  opacity: 0.12;
}

.accent-lines &gt; div:nth-child(1) &gt; div:nth-child(2)::before {
  right: 24em;
  rotate: 45deg;
  translate: -2.5em 2.5em;
}

.accent-lines &gt; div:nth-child(1) &gt; div:nth-child(2)::after {
  right: 24em;
  rotate: -45deg;
  translate: -2.5em 2.5em;
}

.accent-lines &gt; div:nth-child(1) &gt; div:nth-child(1)::before,
.accent-lines &gt; div:nth-child(1) &gt; div:nth-child(1)::after {
  display: block;
  width: 5em;
  height: 1px;
  border-radius: 0;
  opacity: 0.12;
}

.accent-lines &gt; div:nth-child(1) &gt; div:nth-child(1)::before {
  left: 24em;
  rotate: 45deg;
  translate: 2.5em 7.5em;
}

.accent-lines &gt; div:nth-child(1) &gt; div:nth-child(1)::after {
  left: 24em;
  rotate: -45deg;
  translate: 2.5em 7.5em;
}

.accent-lines &gt; div:nth-child(1) &gt; div:nth-child(2)::before,
.accent-lines &gt; div:nth-child(1) &gt; div:nth-child(2)::after {
  opacity: 0;
  scale: 0;
  animation: accentload2 2s ease-out 2.4s forwards;
}

.accent-lines &gt; div:nth-child(1) &gt; div:nth-child(1)::before,
lo .accent-lines &gt; div:nth-child(1) &gt; div:nth-child(1)::after {
  opacity: 0;
  scale: 0;
  animation: accentload3 2s ease-out 2.4s forwards;
}

@keyframes accentload2 {
  0% {
    opacity: 0;
    scale: 0;
    transform: rotate(360deg);
  }

  50% {
    scale: 0;
  }

  100% {
    opacity: 0.12;
    scale: 1;
    transform: rotate(0deg);
  }
}

@keyframes accentload3 {
  0% {
    opacity: 0;
    scale: 0;
    transform: rotate(-360deg);
  }

  50% {
    scale: 0;
  }

  100% {
    opacity: 0.12;
    scale: 1;
    transform: rotate(0deg);
  }
}

/* Container */
.hint,
.anchor-node-icon {
  width: var(--hint-size);
  height: var(--hint-size);
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
}

/* Rotated square */
.hint::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  background: var(--hint-color);
  clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 100% 50%, 50% 100%, 0 50%);
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  z-index: 2;
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* Pulsing glow */
.hint::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  width: 2px;
  height: 2px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  z-index: 1;
  box-shadow: 0 0 50px 30px var(--glow-color);
  animation: glow var(--anim-duration) cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.2, 1) infinite;
  transition: opacity 0.5s ease;
  pointer-events: none;
}

@keyframes glow {
  0% {
    box-shadow: var(--glow-initial);
  }

  70% {
    box-shadow: var(--glow-mid);
  }

  100% {
    box-shadow: var(--glow-final);
  }
}

/* Animated border dot */
.hint-dot {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 3;
  width: var(--hint-size);
  height: var(--hint-size);
  border: 1px solid var(--hint-color);
  border-radius: 50%;
  transform: scale(0.95);
  animation: borderAnim var(--anim-duration) linear infinite;
  pointer-events: none;
}

@keyframes borderAnim {
  0%,
  100% {
    border-color: var(--border-initial);
    transform: scale(0.95);
  }

  50% {
    border-color: var(--border-mid);
    transform: scale(1);
  }
}

/* Expanding radius */
.hint-radius {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  width: var(--radius-size);
  height: var(--radius-size);
  margin: calc(-1 * var(--radius-size) / 2);
  background: var(--radius-bg);
  border-radius: 50%;
  transform: scale(0);
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  transition:
    transform var(--radius-trans),
    opacity var(--radius-trans),
    visibility var(--radius-trans);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.hint:hover .hint-radius {
  transform: scale(1);
  opacity: 1;
  visibility: visible;
}

/* Tooltip content */
.hint-content {
  position: absolute;
  top: -82%;
  left: 53%;
  margin-left: 56px;
  width: var(--content-width);
  padding: var(--content-padding);
  color: var(--hint-color);
  z-index: 5;
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  transition:
    opacity 0.7s ease,
    visibility 0.7s ease;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.hint:hover &gt; .hint-content {
  opacity: 1;
  visibility: visible;
}

/* Underline animations */
.hint-content::before,
.hint-content::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  background: var(--hint-color);
  height: 1px;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  transition: width 0.4s;
}

.hint-content::before {
  width: 0;
}

.hint:hover .hint-content::before {
  width: 180px;
}

.hint-content::after {
  width: 80px;
  transform-origin: 0 50%;
  transform: rotate(-225deg);
  transition: opacity 0.5s ease;
  opacity: 1;
}
